name: Yushu
queryAndRequestSummary: Separate English and Chinese first-party discovery was completed. The official Jilin Tianditu platform was followed through its current HTML, JavaScript/configuration, city-node, region extent, and map-query configuration endpoints. The exact WUP point was retained and confirmed inside 榆树市 administrative extent, but no public cadastral parcel layer, safe native parcel ID, schema, CRS, or polygon response was available.
scopeLimits: No parcel sample GeoJSON was created because no safe native parcel identity and full polygon geometry were observed.
Administrative extent membership is not evidence of a cadastral hit or citywide parcel availability.
A disabled municipal platform node, 404 guessed endpoint, and 403 registration page are access/configuration outcomes, not evidence of citywide absence.
No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS exception, or unsafe attribute request was used.
uncertainty: The official geospatial custodian and local Yushu municipal extent are evidenced, but no local cadastral registry/map/procedure or anonymous parcel geometry was evidenced. The point/name ambiguity was preserved as a research caveat; the WUP point was not shifted.
